notifications.title: Set one end screen on each long video
notifications.detail: Guides rate a single, specific next video as the best ending for session watch time. End screens can only be set in YouTube Studio, at upload.
notifications.fix: 1. When uploading a long video, open Editor → End screen. 2. Add one 'Video' element pointing to our closest long video in subject. 3. Add the Subscribe element. Nothing else.

notifications.title: Long-video topics run out of winning Shorts around 26 Nov
notifications.detail: scout.md says every long topic expands a Short with 1,000+ views 'in the last 30 days'. Our five 1K Shorts were published 21-27 Oct, so they leave that window between 20 and 26 Nov. No Short published since has 1K: the gym Short (v-20261105-06) has 920, and the other 11 have 16-469. The code (generator/topics.py winning_short) checks views but not the date, so Scout and Studio will keep using the October Shorts unless you say otherwise.
notifications.fix: Pick one: 1. Keep it as the code does: any Short that ever reached 1,000 views qualifies (no change needed). 2. Enforce 30 days: ask the auditor/improver to add a publishAt check to winning_short. Long videos then pause from about 26 Nov until a new Short reaches 1K. 3. Lower the bar for long topics, for example to 750 views (WIN_VIEWS in generator/topics.py).
